source.title: File:2017 Moscow Bogorodskoye Church 02.jpg
source.author: Andrey Korzun
source.description: Church of the Transfiguration of the Lord in Bogorodskoye, Moscow. 1877-1880. Built in the village of Bogorodskoye, which in the XX century became part of the city. The only surviving wooden church in Moscow.
source.name: Храм Преображения в Богородском
source.strength: Цельный силуэт, колокольня, резные карнизы и розовые деревянные стены. Подходит для вырезки на цветовое поле.
source.limits: Навес и ограждение у нижней части фасада; на заднем плане жилые дома.

geometry: Preserve original photographic viewpoint and real roof slopes. No deterministic rectification needed.
observed: Three visible unequal roof accents with their original crosses; an open central belfry with a visible bell; left gabled entrance and linked right wing; carved white trim and wooden wall boards; the same oblique viewpoint and roof proportions.
user_confirmed: Four selected objects, including Красный богатырь.
unconfirmed_excluded: Building dates and architects not used.
